creators.name: Joon Sung Park
creators.role: HCI researcher; co-founder and CEO of Simile
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者，Simile 联合创始人兼 CEO
creators.bio: Stanford computer science PhD who introduced generative agents in the 2023 Smallville paper and then built agents grounded in two-hour interviews with 1,052 Americans. Co-founded Simile with Michael Bernstein and Percy Liang.
creators.bio_zh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学博士，2023 年以 Smallville 论文提出生成式智能体，随后用 1,052 名美国人的两小时访谈构建个体智能体。与 Michael Bernstein、Percy Liang 共同创办 Simile。
creators.why: His memory, reflection and planning architecture is the template most social simulations and LLM NPCs build on.
creators.why_zh: 他提出的记忆、反思与计划架构，是如今大多数社会模拟与 LLM NPC 的基础模板。

creators.name: Simile
creators.role_zh: 人类行为模拟公司
creators.bio: Company founded by Joon Sung Park, Michael Bernstein and Percy Liang that turns generative-agent research into simulations of customers and populations. It came out of stealth in February 2026.
creators.bio_zh: 由 Joon Sung Park、Michael Bernstein 与 Percy Liang 创办，把生成式智能体研究做成对客户与人群的模拟。2026 年 2 月公开亮相。
creators.why: The first well-funded company selling simulations of real people, raising the same validity questions behavioral researchers face.
creators.why_zh: 第一家获得大额融资、出售真实人群模拟的公司，它面对的效度问题也正是行为研究者要回答的问题。

creators.name: Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)
creators.role_zh: 风险投资机构（a16z 基础设施团队）
creators.bio: Venture firm whose infrastructure team released AI Town with Convex in 2023: an MIT-licensed starter kit for a browser town of chatting LLM characters.
creators.bio_zh: 风险投资机构，其基础设施团队于 2023 年与 Convex 合作发布 AI Town：一个 MIT 许可、可在浏览器中运行的 LLM 角色小镇起步套件。
creators.why: Made the Smallville idea something anyone could deploy and modify.
creators.why_zh: 让 Smallville 的想法变成任何人都能部署和改造的项目。

creators.name: Altera (Fundamental Research Labs)
creators.role_zh: AI 智能体初创公司
creators.bio: Startup building autonomous digital humans; in 2024 it ran Project Sid, simulations of 10 to more than 1,000 LLM agents in Minecraft. Its YouTube channel now carries the name Fundamental Research Labs.
creators.bio_zh: 构建自主数字人的初创公司；2024 年推出 Project Sid，在 Minecraft 中模拟 10 到 1,000 多个 LLM 智能体。其 YouTube 频道现名 Fundamental Research Labs。
creators.why: Showed what happens to roles, rules and culture when hundreds of agents share one persistent world.
creators.why_zh: 展示了数百个智能体共享同一个持续世界时，分工、规则与文化会如何演化。

creators.name: Google DeepMind
creators.role_zh: 谷歌旗下的人工智能研究实验室
creators.bio: Google's AI lab (Gemini, Genie, Veo). Its SIMA project trains agents that follow language instructions in commercial 3D games and, with SIMA 2, in worlds generated by Genie 3; it also maintains the Concordia library for generative social simulation.
creators.bio_zh: 谷歌的人工智能实验室（Gemini、Genie、Veo）。其 SIMA 项目训练能在商业三维游戏中听从语言指令的智能体，SIMA 2 还进入了 Genie 3 生成的世界；它也维护用于生成式社会模拟的 Concordia 库。
creators.why: Connects world models and embodied agents: the same lab generates the worlds and the agents that act in them.
creators.why_zh: 把世界模型与具身智能体连在一起：同一个实验室既生成世界，也训练在其中行动的智能体。

creators.name: Tsinghua University FIB Lab
creators.role: Research lab, Department of Electronic Engineering, Tsinghua University
creators.role_zh: 清华大学电子工程系研究实验室
creators.bio: Lab led by Yong Li working on urban science and LLM agents; released the AgentSociety simulator in 2025.
creators.bio_zh: 由李勇领导的实验室，研究城市科学与大语言模型智能体；2025 年发布 AgentSociety 模拟器。
creators.why: Builds city-scale agent societies as testbeds for social-science experiments.
creators.why_zh: 构建城市尺度的智能体社会，作为社会科学实验的试验台。
creators.name_zh: 清华大学 FIB 实验室

creators.name: CAMEL-AI
creators.role_zh: 开源多智能体研究社区
creators.bio: Open-source community behind the CAMEL multi-agent framework and OASIS, a social-media simulator for up to one million LLM agents.
creators.bio_zh: CAMEL 多智能体框架与 OASIS 背后的开源社区；OASIS 是可容纳一百万个 LLM 智能体的社交媒体模拟器。
creators.why: Scaled LLM social simulation to a million users on X- and Reddit-like platforms.
creators.why_zh: 把 LLM 社会模拟扩展到一百万用户规模，覆盖类 X 与类 Reddit 平台。

creators.name: OpenAI
creators.role_zh: 人工智能研究与产品公司
creators.bio: Developer of GPT, Sora and the realtime voice models; in 2019 its multi-agent hide-and-seek study showed agents inventing tool use in a 3D physics world.
creators.bio_zh: GPT、Sora 与实时语音模型的开发者；2019 年的多智能体捉迷藏研究展示了智能体在三维物理世界中自发学会使用工具。
creators.why: An early, widely seen demonstration that agents in a simulated world can produce behavior nobody scripted.
creators.why_zh: 较早且广为人知地展示了：模拟世界中的智能体可以产生没有人编写过的行为。

creators.name: NVIDIA
creators.role_zh: GPU 与人工智能计算公司
creators.bio: Maker of GPUs and of ACE, a stack of speech, language and facial-animation models for game characters; its research groups also built the Voyager and NitroGen game agents.
creators.bio_zh: GPU 厂商，并推出 ACE：一套面向游戏角色的语音、语言与面部动画模型；其研究团队还开发了 Voyager 与 NitroGen 等游戏智能体。
creators.why: Sets the reference stack for talking game characters and runs them on local GPUs.
creators.why_zh: 为会说话的游戏角色提供参考技术栈，并让它们在本地 GPU 上运行。

creators.name: Guanzhi Wang
creators.role_zh: 人工智能研究者（加州理工学院、英伟达）
creators.bio: Caltech PhD researcher working with NVIDIA; first author of Voyager (2023), an LLM agent that explores Minecraft by writing and storing code skills.
creators.bio_zh: 加州理工学院博士研究者，与英伟达合作；Voyager（2023）的第一作者，该智能体通过编写并保存代码技能来探索 Minecraft。
creators.why: Voyager turned LLM agents in open game worlds into a research line of its own.
creators.why_zh: Voyager 让“开放游戏世界中的 LLM 智能体”成为一条独立的研究路线。

creators.name: Weihao Tan
creators.role_zh: 人工智能研究者，游戏智能体方向
creators.bio: First author of Cradle (2024), which played Red Dead Redemption 2 from screenshots and keyboard-mouse output, and of Lumine (2025, ByteDance Seed), which completes hours-long Genshin Impact missions in real time.
creators.bio_zh: Cradle（2024）与 Lumine（2025，字节跳动 Seed）的第一作者：前者通过截图和键鼠输出游玩《荒野大镖客 2》，后者能实时完成数小时的《原神》任务。
creators.why: His two projects trace the shift from slow screenshot agents to real-time open-world agents.
creators.why_zh: 他的两个项目勾勒出从缓慢的截图式智能体到实时开放世界智能体的转变。

creators.name: Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI)
creators.role_zh: 非营利人工智能研究机构
creators.bio: Non-profit research institute in Beijing; its agents team released Cradle, a framework for general computer control tested in commercial games and software.
creators.bio_zh: 位于北京的非营利研究机构；其智能体团队发布了 Cradle，一个在商业游戏与软件中测试的通用计算机控制框架。
creators.why: Pushed foundation-model agents from APIs to the same screen-and-keyboard interface players use.
creators.why_zh: 把基础模型智能体从 API 调用推向与玩家相同的屏幕加键鼠界面。
creators.name_zh: 北京智源人工智能研究院

creators.name: ByteDance Seed
creators.role_zh: 字节跳动的基础模型研究团队
creators.bio: Research team building ByteDance's foundation models (Doubao, Seedance, UI-TARS); in 2025 it released the game agents Game-TARS and Lumine.
creators.bio_zh: 构建字节跳动基础模型（豆包、Seedance、UI-TARS）的研究团队；2025 年发布游戏智能体 Game-TARS 与 Lumine。
creators.why: One of the few labs training generalist agents for real-time play in commercial 3D games.
creators.why_zh: 少数训练通用智能体在商业三维游戏中实时游玩的实验室之一。

creators.name: Convai
creators.role: Conversational AI platform for game and XR characters
creators.role_zh: 面向游戏与 XR 角色的对话式 AI 平台
creators.bio: Startup that provides an engine and plugins for characters that talk, perceive and act in Unreal Engine, Unity and web 3D; it built NVIDIA's 2023 Kairos demo with ACE.
creators.bio_zh: 为 Unreal Engine、Unity 与网页三维场景提供能说话、感知和行动的角色引擎与插件；2023 年与英伟达用 ACE 合作制作了 Kairos 演示。
creators.why: One of the main off-the-shelf ways to put LLM-driven characters into games and XR training scenes.
creators.why_zh: 把 LLM 驱动角色放进游戏和 XR 训练场景的主要现成途径之一。

creators.name: Inworld AI
creators.role: Real-time AI company, formerly an AI character engine for games
creators.role_zh: 实时 AI 公司，前身是游戏 AI 角色引擎
creators.bio: Founded in 2021 to build an engine for AI game characters, used in Ubisoft's NEO NPC and NVIDIA's Covert Protocol demos. By 2026 it mainly markets real-time voice models (TTS, STT, speech-to-speech) and a runtime for consumer AI apps.
creators.bio_zh: 2021 年成立，最初为游戏 AI 角色打造引擎，育碧 NEO NPC 与英伟达 Covert Protocol 演示都使用了它。到 2026 年，它主要推广实时语音模型（TTS、STT、语音到语音）以及面向消费级 AI 应用的运行时。
creators.why: Its path shows how NPC platforms turned into general real-time voice infrastructure.
creators.why_zh: 它的转型说明了 NPC 平台如何演变为通用的实时语音基础设施。

creators.name: Ubisoft
creators.role_zh: 电子游戏发行商
creators.bio: French publisher of Assassin's Creed and The Division; its Paris teams showed the NEO NPC prototype in 2024 and the playable Teammates experiment in 2025.
creators.bio_zh: 《刺客信条》《全境封锁》的法国发行商；其巴黎团队在 2024 年展示 NEO NPC 原型，2025 年推出可游玩的 Teammates 实验。
creators.why: A major publisher testing voice-driven generative NPCs with real players.
creators.why_zh: 一家大型发行商在真实玩家身上测试语音驱动的生成式 NPC。

creators.name: KRAFTON
creators.role_zh: 电子游戏发行商
creators.bio: South Korean publisher of PUBG: Battlegrounds and inZOI; with NVIDIA ACE it introduced 'Co-Playable Characters' that run on small on-device language models.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国游戏公司，发行《绝地求生》与 inZOI；与英伟达 ACE 合作推出运行在本地小语言模型上的“可共玩角色”（CPC）。
creators.why: Puts on-device LLM teammates and autonomous citizens into mass-market games.
creators.why_zh: 把本地运行的 LLM 队友与自主市民放进大众市场游戏。

creators.name: Epic Games
creators.role: Game developer and engine maker (Fortnite, Unreal Engine)
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发商与引擎厂商（Fortnite、Unreal Engine）
creators.bio: Developer of Fortnite and Unreal Engine; launched a voice-chat AI Darth Vader in Fortnite in 2025 and opened the technology to creators as the Persona device, later called Conversations.
creators.bio_zh: Fortnite 与 Unreal Engine 的开发商；2025 年在 Fortnite 中上线可语音对话的 AI 达斯·维达，随后以 Persona 装置（后更名 Conversations）向创作者开放这项技术。
creators.why: Brought conversational NPCs to one of the largest game audiences and to user-made islands.
creators.why_zh: 把对话式 NPC 带给规模最大的游戏玩家群体之一，以及玩家自制的岛屿。
creators.based_zh: 美国北卡罗来纳州卡里

creators.name: Anuttacon
creators.role_zh: AI 游戏工作室
creators.bio: Studio founded by miHoYo co-founder Cai Haoyu to make AI-native games; released Whispers from the Star in 2025.
creators.bio_zh: 由米哈游联合创始人蔡浩宇创办的 AI 原生游戏工作室；2025 年发布《Whispers from the Star》。
creators.why: An early commercial game built entirely around open-ended voice conversation with one AI character.
creators.why_zh: 较早完全围绕与单个 AI 角色开放式语音对话而构建的商业游戏。

creators.name: Proxima
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室
creators.bio: Small studio behind Suck Up!, a comedy game in which players talk AI-driven townsfolk into letting a vampire in.
creators.bio_zh: 《Suck Up!》背后的小型工作室；在这款喜剧游戏里，玩家要说服由 AI 驱动的镇民让吸血鬼进门。
creators.why: An indie proof that free-form persuasion of LLM characters can be the whole game mechanic.
creators.why_zh: 一个独立游戏证明：对 LLM 角色的自由说服本身就可以构成整个玩法。

creators.name: NetEase Games
creators.role_zh: 电子游戏开发商与发行商
creators.bio: Chinese game company behind Justice Online, Eggy Party and NARAKA: BLADEPOINT; it shipped LLM-driven NPCs in Justice Online Mobile in 2023 and an on-device NVIDIA ACE AI teammate in NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Mobile PC Version in 2025.
creators.bio_zh: 中国游戏公司，旗下有《逆水寒》《蛋仔派对》《永劫无间》；2023 年在《逆水寒》手游中上线 LLM 驱动的 NPC，2025 年在《永劫无间》手游 PC 版中上线基于英伟达 ACE、本地运行的 AI 队友。
creators.why: Shows Chinese studios shipping LLM characters to very large player bases.
creators.why_zh: 说明中国游戏公司已在超大规模玩家群体中上线 LLM 角色。

works.title: Generative Agents (Smallville)
works.description: Twenty-five LLM-driven characters live in Smallville, a pixel-art town: they wake, work, gossip, form opinions and remember each other. Seeded with one agent's wish to host a Valentine's Day party, the others spread invitations, ask each other on dates and show up at the right time.
works.description_zh: 25 个由大语言模型驱动的角色生活在像素风小镇 Smallville：起床、工作、闲聊、形成看法，并记得彼此。研究者只给一个角色设定“想办情人节派对”的念头，其他角色便自发传播邀请、互相约会，并在约定时间到场。
works.idea_en: Memory, reflection and planning on top of an LLM are enough to make a small society that coordinates over days without a script.
works.idea_zh: 在大语言模型之上加入记忆、反思与计划，就足以让一个小社会在没有脚本的情况下跨越数天彼此协调。
works.method: Each agent keeps a natural-language memory stream; retrieval by recency, importance and relevance feeds GPT-3.5 prompts that write reflections and hierarchical day plans, which a sandbox game engine turns into movement and dialogue; believability was rated by human evaluators against ablations.
works.method_zh: 每个智能体保存一条自然语言记忆流；按时间近度、重要性与相关性检索记忆，输入 GPT-3.5 生成反思与分层的日程计划，再由沙盒游戏引擎转化为移动与对话；可信度由人类评估者与消融版本对比打分。

paper.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior

works.title: Generative Agent Simulations of 1,000 People
works.description: Stanford researchers interviewed 1,052 Americans for two hours each and turned every transcript into an agent that answers surveys, personality tests and economic games as that person would. The agents were scored against the participants' own answers given two weeks later.
works.description_zh: 斯坦福研究者对 1,052 名美国人各做了两小时访谈，把每份访谈记录变成一个智能体，让它像本人一样回答问卷、人格测验与经济博弈。评估标准是参与者本人两周后再次作答的一致性。
works.idea_en: Agents grounded in a real person's own words, not demographics, can stand in for that individual on held-out questions; this is the bridge from Smallville to participant 'digital twins' in behavioral research.
works.idea_zh: 以真实个体自己的话（而非人口统计标签）为基础的智能体，能在未见过的问题上替代这个人作答；这是从 Smallville 走向行为研究中参与者“数字孪生”的桥梁。
works.method: An AI interviewer ran semi-structured American Voices Project interviews; full transcripts were placed in an LLM's context to build per-person agents, evaluated on General Social Survey items, Big Five, economic games and replicated experiments, normalised by each participant's two-week test-retest consistency.
works.method_zh: 由 AI 访谈员按 American Voices Project 提纲进行半结构化访谈；将完整访谈记录放入大语言模型上下文，构建每个人的智能体，并在综合社会调查（GSS）题目、大五人格、经济博弈与复现实验上评估，以参与者本人两周重测一致性作归一化。
works.specs: 1,052 participants · 2-hour interviews · 83–86% of test-retest consistency on GSS

paper.title: LLM Agents Grounded in Self-Reports Enable General-Purpose Simulation of Individuals

works.title: AI Town
works.description: A deployable, MIT-licensed town in the browser where LLM characters walk around, start conversations and remember them; a visitor can join as a character and chat with the residents.
works.description_zh: 一个可部署、MIT 许可的浏览器小镇：LLM 角色四处走动、主动搭话并记住对话；访客也可以作为一个角色加入，与居民聊天。
works.idea_en: Turned the generative-agents paper into a template people fork for their own simulated communities and games.
works.idea_zh: 把生成式智能体论文变成一个模板，人们可以复刻它来搭建自己的模拟社群与游戏。
works.method: A TypeScript game loop on the Convex reactive database stores world state, agent memories and embeddings, and calls a hosted or local LLM (OpenAI, Together or Ollama) for conversations and memory summaries.
works.method_zh: 基于 Convex 响应式数据库的 TypeScript 游戏循环保存世界状态、智能体记忆与向量嵌入，并调用托管或本地大语言模型（OpenAI、Together 或 Ollama）生成对话与记忆摘要。

works.title: Project Sid
works.description: Up to more than 1,000 LLM agents share a Minecraft server for hours: they take on roles such as farmer or guard, vote to change a tax law, and pass a parody religion from agent to agent.
works.description_zh: 多达 1,000 多个 LLM 智能体在同一个 Minecraft 服务器里共同生活数小时：它们自发分工成农民、守卫等角色，投票修改税法，还把一种戏仿宗教在彼此之间传播。
works.idea_en: Scale changes the questions: with hundreds of agents in one persistent world, you can watch institutions and culture form, or fail to.
works.idea_zh: 规模改变了问题：数百个智能体共处一个持续世界时，可以观察制度与文化如何形成或瓦解。
works.method: The PIANO architecture runs concurrent modules (memory, action, talking, social awareness, goals) and a cognitive controller that keeps an agent's speech and actions coherent in real time; societies were scored on civilizational benchmarks such as specialization, rule adherence and meme transmission.
works.method_zh: PIANO 架构让多个模块（记忆、行动、对话、社会感知、目标）并发运行，再由认知控制器实时保持智能体言行一致；以“文明基准”评估社会表现，如分工、规则遵守与文化传播。

paper.title: Project Sid: Many-agent simulations toward AI civilization

works.title: Concordia
works.description: An open-source Python library for generative agent-based models: researchers write characters and a scenario, and a 'Game Master' agent narrates what happens when the characters act, much like a tabletop role-playing game.
works.description_zh: 一个开源的 Python 生成式智能体建模库：研究者编写角色与情境，再由一个“游戏主持人”（Game Master）智能体叙述角色行动的后果，类似桌面角色扮演游戏。
works.idea_en: Separates who acts from what the world says happened, which gives social scientists one place to set, log and audit the rules of a simulated situation.
works.idea_zh: 把“谁在行动”与“世界判定发生了什么”分开，让社会科学研究者能在一个地方设定、记录和审查模拟情境的规则。
works.method: Agents are built from composable LLM components (memory, observation, plans, identity); the Game Master resolves free-text actions into events grounded in physical, social or digital state; v2.0 restructured the components, and the NeurIPS 2024 Concordia Contest used it for cooperation research.
works.method_zh: 智能体由可组合的 LLM 组件（记忆、观察、计划、身份）构成；游戏主持人把自由文本行动裁定为基于物理、社会或数字状态的事件；2.0 版重构了组件体系，NeurIPS 2024 的 Concordia Contest 用它研究合作行为。

paper.title: Generative agent-based modeling with actions grounded in physical, social, or digital space using Concordia

works.title: AgentSociety
works.description: A simulator that gives more than 10,000 LLM agents jobs, homes, mobility and social ties inside a modelled city, then runs social experiments on them: polarization, inflammatory messages, universal basic income and a hurricane shock.
works.description_zh: 一个模拟器：让一万多个 LLM 智能体在建模的城市中拥有工作、住所、出行与社会关系，再在其上开展社会实验，包括极化、煽动性信息传播、全民基本收入与飓风冲击。
works.idea_en: Treats an agent population as a lab where interventions that are unethical or impossible with people can be piloted first.
works.idea_zh: 把智能体人群当作实验室，先行试验那些在真人身上不道德或无法实施的干预。
works.method: LLM agents with needs, emotions and memories act in an urban environment (mobility, economy, social network) on a distributed simulation engine; the authors report about 5 million agent and environment interactions and compare outcomes with findings from human studies.
works.method_zh: 具备需求、情绪与记忆的 LLM 智能体在城市环境（出行、经济、社交网络）中行动，运行于分布式模拟引擎之上；作者报告约 500 万次智能体之间及与环境的交互，并与真人研究结论对比。

paper.title: AgentSociety: Large-Scale Simulation of LLM-Driven Generative Agents Advances Understanding of Human Behaviors and Society

works.title: OASIS
works.description: A social-media simulator in which up to one million LLM agents follow, post, comment and repost on X- and Reddit-like platforms with recommendation feeds, used to replicate information spread, group polarization and herd effects.
works.description_zh: 一个社交媒体模拟器：多达一百万个 LLM 智能体在带推荐流的类 X、类 Reddit 平台上关注、发帖、评论与转发，用来复现信息扩散、群体极化与从众效应。
works.idea_en: Lets you test how a feed algorithm or a rumor changes a crowd before trying anything on real users.
works.idea_zh: 可以先在模拟人群中测试推荐算法或谣言会如何改变群体，再考虑在真实用户身上尝试。
works.method: Agents built on the CAMEL framework act through a shared action space over a dynamic social graph; an environment server and interest- or hot-score-based recommender update what each agent sees, and parallel LLM inference lets it scale to very large populations.
works.method_zh: 基于 CAMEL 框架的智能体在动态社交图上通过统一的动作空间行动；环境服务器与基于兴趣或热度的推荐系统决定每个智能体看到的内容，并借助并行的大语言模型推理扩展到超大规模人群。

paper.title: OASIS: Open Agent Social Interaction Simulations with One Million Agents

works.title: Simile
works.description: A commercial platform that simulates how real customer groups would respond to a product launch, price change or campaign, using agents built from interviews and survey data in the line of the Stanford 1,000-person study. In July 2026 it raised over US$200 million at a US$2 billion post-money valuation and reported a foundation model of human behavior and a confidence model that predicts each simulation's accuracy.
works.description_zh: 一个商业平台，用访谈与问卷数据构建的智能体，模拟真实客户群体对产品发布、价格调整或营销活动的反应，延续斯坦福 1,000 人研究的思路。2026 年 7 月，Simile 以 20 亿美元投后估值融资逾 2 亿美元，并称已建成人类行为基础模型，以及可预测每次模拟准确度的置信度模型。
works.idea_en: Population simulation has become a product; its accuracy claims are exactly what behavioral researchers would need to check before using such twins as participants.
works.idea_zh: 人群模拟已经成为产品；它的准确性声明，正是行为研究者把这类“数字孪生”当作被试之前必须检验的内容。
works.method: Likely the generative-agent architecture with interview-grounded personas, validated by comparing simulated and held-out human response distributions; Simile reports enterprise studies (e.g. with CVS Health) but does not publish full model details.
works.method_zh: 很可能沿用以访谈为基础人设的生成式智能体架构，并通过比较模拟回答与留出的真人回答分布来验证；Simile 披露了与企业（如 CVS Health）的合作研究，但未公开完整模型细节。

works.title: Multi-Agent Hide and Seek
works.description: Teams of hiders and seekers trained by reinforcement learning in a 3D physics world discover, over hundreds of millions of games, how to build forts from boxes, use ramps to climb walls and exploit physics glitches.
works.description_zh: 在三维物理世界中通过强化学习训练的躲藏者与寻找者队伍，在数亿局游戏中自己学会用箱子搭堡垒、用坡道翻墙，甚至利用物理引擎漏洞。
works.idea_en: A precursor of agents in worlds: competition alone produced a sequence of strategies nobody designed.
works.idea_zh: “世界中的智能体”的先声：仅靠对抗，就产生了一连串没人设计过的策略。
works.method: Multi-agent self-play with PPO and entity-centric attention policies in a MuJoCo environment; six phases of emergent strategy were identified and compared with intrinsic-motivation baselines.
works.method_zh: 在 MuJoCo 环境中，用 PPO 与以实体为中心的注意力策略进行多智能体自我博弈；识别出六个阶段的涌现策略，并与内在动机基线对比。

paper.title: Emergent Tool Use From Multi-Agent Autocurricula

works.title: XLand: Open-Ended Learning Agents
works.description: Agents trained in XLand, a procedurally generated universe of 3D worlds and multiplayer games, learn general behaviors such as experimenting, cooperating and using objects, and then play held-out games like hide-and-seek and capture the flag without further training.
works.description_zh: 在 XLand（一个由程序生成的三维世界与多人游戏构成的宇宙）中训练的智能体，学会了尝试、合作、利用物体等通用行为，随后无需再训练就能玩捉迷藏、夺旗等未见过的游戏。
works.idea_en: A precursor of SIMA and of agents in generated worlds: generality came from training across a generated space of situations rather than one handcrafted task.
works.idea_zh: SIMA 与“生成世界中的智能体”的先声：通用性来自在生成的情境空间中训练，而不是单一的人工任务。
works.method: Deep reinforcement learning with population-based training and a dynamic curriculum that generates worlds, goals and co-players matched to each agent's current ability, evaluated zero-shot on held-out tasks.
works.method_zh: 采用基于种群的深度强化学习，并以动态课程按每个智能体当前能力生成世界、目标与同伴，在留出的任务上进行零样本评估。

paper.title: Open-Ended Learning Leads to Generally Capable Agents

works.title: Voyager
works.description: A GPT-4 agent that plays Minecraft without human input: it proposes its own next goals, writes JavaScript to reach them, and saves working code as reusable skills, going from punching trees to mining diamonds.
works.description_zh: 一个无需人工干预、自己玩 Minecraft 的 GPT-4 智能体：它自行提出下一个目标，编写 JavaScript 代码去完成，并把有效代码存为可复用技能，从徒手砍树一路做到挖出钻石。
works.idea_en: An agent that stores what it learns as code can keep growing in an open world, a pattern later NPC and world-agent systems reuse.
works.idea_zh: 把学到的东西存成代码的智能体，能在开放世界里持续成长；后来的 NPC 与世界智能体系统也沿用了这一模式。
works.method: An automatic curriculum, an iterative prompting loop with environment feedback, execution errors and self-verification, and a vector-indexed skill library drive GPT-4 through the Mineflayer API; the authors report 3.3x more unique items and up to 15.3x faster tech-tree progress than prior methods.
works.method_zh: 由自动课程、结合环境反馈与执行报错和自我验证的迭代提示循环，以及向量索引的技能库，通过 Mineflayer API 驱动 GPT-4；作者报告获取的独特物品数为此前方法的 3.3 倍，科技树进度最快提升 15.3 倍。

paper.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models

works.title: SIMA
works.description: A Scalable Instructable Multiworld Agent that watches the screen and presses keys to follow spoken-style instructions such as 'chop down the tree' or 'open the map' across nine commercial games, including No Man's Sky, Valheim and Teardown, and four research environments.
works.description_zh: “可扩展、可指令、多世界”智能体：观看屏幕画面并按键操作，在《无人深空》《英灵神殿》《拆迁》等九款商业游戏和四个研究环境中执行“砍倒那棵树”“打开地图”之类的语言指令。
works.idea_en: Uses the same pixels-in, keyboard-out interface as a human, so one agent can enter any game, including generated worlds, without an API.
works.idea_zh: 采用与人相同的“像素输入、键鼠输出”接口，因此一个智能体无需 API 就能进入任何游戏，包括生成的世界。
works.method: Pretrained image and video encoders plus a text encoder feed a transformer policy trained by behavioral cloning on human gameplay annotated with instructions; about 600 basic skills of roughly 10 seconds were evaluated.
works.method_zh: 预训练的图像与视频编码器加上文本编码器，输入一个 Transformer 策略，在带指令标注的人类游戏录像上做行为克隆训练；共评估约 600 个时长约 10 秒的基础技能。

paper.title: Scaling Instructable Agents Across Many Simulated Worlds

works.title: SIMA 2
works.description: A Gemini-based game companion that reasons about goals, talks with the player, follows instructions given as text in several languages, emoji or images, and carries skills into games it has never seen, including 3D worlds generated on the fly by Genie 3.
works.description_zh: 基于 Gemini 的游戏伙伴：能推理目标、与玩家交谈，理解多种语言的文字、表情符号或图像形式的指令，并把技能带到从未见过的游戏中，包括 Genie 3 即时生成的三维世界。
works.idea_en: The first public pairing of a generalist agent with a world model: Genie 3 makes the world, SIMA 2 acts in it and improves there without new human data.
works.idea_zh: 首次公开把通用智能体与世界模型配对：Genie 3 生成世界，SIMA 2 在其中行动，并在不需要新人类数据的情况下自我提升。
works.method: A Gemini foundation model fine-tuned on human gameplay and Gemini-labelled data maps screen frames and instructions to keyboard-mouse actions; in a self-improvement loop Gemini proposes tasks and estimates rewards, and the agent's own trajectories train its next version.
works.method_zh: 在人类游戏数据与 Gemini 标注数据上微调的 Gemini 基础模型，把屏幕画面与指令映射为键鼠动作；在自我提升循环中，由 Gemini 提出任务并估计奖励，智能体自身的轨迹用于训练下一代版本。

paper.title: SIMA 2: A Generalist Embodied Agent for Virtual Worlds

works.title: Cradle
works.description: A framework that lets a multimodal LLM play Red Dead Redemption 2's main story missions using only screenshots and keyboard-mouse output, and that transfers to Stardew Valley, Cities: Skylines and everyday software.
works.description_zh: 一个框架，让多模态大语言模型只凭截图和键鼠输出就能完成《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》的主线任务，并可迁移到《星露谷物语》《城市：天际线》和日常软件。
works.idea_en: Showed that a general agent can enter a commercial 3D game through the same screen a player sees, at the price of being far slower than real time.
works.idea_zh: 证明通用智能体可以通过与玩家相同的屏幕进入商业三维游戏，代价是速度远低于实时。
works.method: GPT-4V / GPT-4o models run a loop of information gathering, self-reflection, task inference, skill curation, action planning and memory, writing and reusing skill code that issues keyboard and mouse events.
works.method_zh: 由 GPT-4V / GPT-4o 模型循环执行信息收集、自我反思、任务推断、技能整理、动作规划与记忆，编写并复用发出键鼠事件的技能代码。

paper.title: Cradle: Empowering Foundation Agents Towards General Computer Control

works.title: Lumine
works.description: A vision-language agent that plays Genshin Impact in real time, finishing the five-hour Mondstadt main storyline at roughly human pace, and without fine-tuning completes 100-minute missions in Wuthering Waves and the first chapter of Honkai: Star Rail.
works.description_zh: 一个视觉语言智能体，能实时游玩《原神》，以接近人类的效率完成五小时的蒙德主线剧情；无需微调，还能完成《鸣潮》中 100 分钟的任务以及《崩坏：星穹铁道》第一章。
works.idea_en: Real-time, hours-long play in a commercial open world means an agent can now be a long-lived companion or test player inside 3D worlds.
works.idea_zh: 能在商业开放世界中实时、连续游玩数小时，意味着智能体可以在三维世界里成为长期陪伴者或测试玩家。
works.method: A vision-language model trained on a curriculum of 1,731 hours of human gameplay (action primitives), 200 hours of instruction-following data and 15 hours of reasoning data reads frames at 5 Hz, emits 30 Hz keyboard-mouse action chunks and calls on reasoning only when needed.
works.method_zh: 一个视觉语言模型按课程式训练：1,731 小时人类游戏录像（动作基元）、200 小时指令跟随数据与 15 小时推理数据，以 5 Hz 读取画面，输出 30 Hz 的键鼠动作块，并只在需要时调用推理。

paper.title: Lumine: An Open Recipe for Building Generalist Agents in 3D Open Worlds

works.title: Game-TARS
works.description: A generalist game agent that controls any game through native keyboard and mouse input; ByteDance reports about twice the previous best success rate on open-world Minecraft tasks and near novice-human generality in unseen web 3D games.
works.description_zh: 一个通过原生键鼠输入操控任意游戏的通用游戏智能体；字节跳动称其在开放世界 Minecraft 任务上的成功率约为此前最佳模型的两倍，在未见过的网页三维游戏中接近新手玩家的泛化水平。
works.idea_en: One action space for every game lets agent training scale like language-model pretraining.
works.idea_zh: 所有游戏共用一个动作空间，让智能体训练可以像语言模型预训练一样扩展。
works.method: Continual pretraining on more than 500B tokens of multimodal trajectories across OS, web and game domains, with a decaying continual loss against causal confusion and a sparse-thinking strategy that reasons only at key steps.
works.method_zh: 在操作系统、网页与游戏领域超过 5,000 亿 token 的多模态轨迹上持续预训练，用衰减式持续损失缓解因果混淆，并采用只在关键步骤推理的稀疏思考策略。

paper.title: Game-TARS: Pretrained Foundation Models for Scalable Generalist Multimodal Game Agents

works.title: NitroGen
works.description: An open vision-action foundation model for gaming agents, trained on 40,000 hours of public gameplay videos from more than 1,000 games, that plays 3D action games, 2D platformers and procedurally generated worlds from raw frames.
works.description_zh: 一个开放的游戏智能体视觉-动作基础模型，在 1,000 多款游戏、共 4 万小时的公开游戏视频上训练，能直接从画面游玩三维动作游戏、二维平台跳跃游戏和程序生成的世界。
works.idea_en: Internet gameplay video becomes training data for agents, the same way it is for video world models.
works.idea_zh: 互联网游戏视频成为智能体的训练数据，正如它是视频世界模型的训练数据一样。
works.method: Player actions are extracted automatically from on-screen controller overlays in gameplay videos, and a unified vision-action model is trained by large-scale behavior cloning; NVIDIA reports up to 52% relative improvement on unseen games over training from scratch.
works.method_zh: 从游戏视频画面中的手柄输入叠加层自动提取玩家动作，再以大规模行为克隆训练统一的视觉-动作模型；英伟达报告其在未见过的游戏上比从零训练最多提升 52%（相对值）。

paper.title: NitroGen: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Gaming Agents

works.title: NVIDIA ACE for Games: Kairos demo
works.description: In a ray-traced Unreal Engine 5 ramen shop, the player speaks to Jin, the owner, and he answers in voice with lip-synced facial animation, staying within his backstory. Shown in the Computex 2023 keynote.
works.description_zh: 在光线追踪的 Unreal Engine 5 拉面店里，玩家开口与店主 Jin 交谈，他用语音回答并带有口型同步的面部动画，且始终符合自己的背景设定。在 Computex 2023 主题演讲中展示。
works.idea_en: The demo that set the template for voice-in, voice-and-face-out game characters: speech recognition, an LLM with a persona, speech synthesis and audio-driven facial animation in one loop.
works.idea_zh: 确立了“语音输入、语音加面部输出”游戏角色模板的演示：语音识别、带人设的大语言模型、语音合成与音频驱动面部动画串成一个循环。
works.method: Convai's character platform runs on NVIDIA ACE modules: Riva speech recognition and synthesis, a NeMo language model given Jin's backstory with guardrails, and Audio2Face generating facial animation from the synthesized voice.
works.method_zh: Convai 的角色平台基于英伟达 ACE 模块运行：Riva 语音识别与合成、注入 Jin 背景故事并带护栏的 NeMo 语言模型，以及根据合成语音生成面部动画的 Audio2Face。

works.title: Covert Protocol
works.description: A GDC 2024 tech demo in which the player is a private detective in a hotel and must talk information out of AI-driven characters; what each character reveals depends on how the conversation goes, so each playthrough differs.
works.description_zh: GDC 2024 上的技术演示：玩家扮演酒店里的私家侦探，必须通过对话从 AI 驱动的角色口中套出信息；角色透露什么取决于对话走向，因此每次游玩都不同。
works.idea_en: Makes conversation itself the game mechanic: social skill, not dialogue-tree choice, decides progress.
works.idea_zh: 让对话本身成为玩法：推进剧情靠的是社交能力，而不是对话树选项。
works.method: Inworld's character engine handles personas, goals and knowledge for each character, while NVIDIA ACE supplies Riva speech recognition and Audio2Face facial animation; the scene is built in Unreal Engine.
works.method_zh: Inworld 角色引擎负责每个角色的人设、目标与知识，英伟达 ACE 提供 Riva 语音识别与 Audio2Face 面部动画；场景基于 Unreal Engine 构建。

works.title: Convai
works.description: A platform for building characters that hold voice conversations, perceive their surroundings and carry out actions such as fetching an object or guiding a player, with plugins for Unreal Engine, Unity and web 3D, and use in VR training scenes.
works.description_zh: 一个用于构建角色的平台：角色能进行语音对话、感知周围环境，并执行取物、引导玩家等动作；提供 Unreal Engine、Unity 与网页三维插件，也用于 VR 训练场景。
works.idea_en: A ready-made path from a written character sheet to an embodied NPC in a 3D or XR scene, without building the speech and action pipeline yourself.
works.idea_zh: 从一份书面角色设定直达三维或 XR 场景中具身 NPC 的现成路径，无需自建语音与动作管线。
works.method: Characters are configured in a web dashboard (backstory, knowledge base, voice, actions); the engine streams speech recognition, LLM responses with action selection, speech synthesis and lip-sync to the game client, and supports NPC-to-NPC conversation and live game-state context.
works.method_zh: 在网页后台配置角色（背景、知识库、声音、动作）；引擎把语音识别、带动作选择的大语言模型回复、语音合成与口型同步流式传给游戏客户端，并支持 NPC 之间的对话与实时游戏状态上下文。

works.title: NEO NPC
works.description: A Ubisoft Paris prototype shown at GDC 2024 in which players negotiate and plan with characters such as Bloom and Iron by speaking freely, while the characters stay within backstories written by a narrative director.
works.description_zh: 育碧巴黎工作室在 GDC 2024 展示的原型：玩家可以自由说话，与 Bloom、Iron 等角色谈判和制定计划，而角色始终保持叙事总监写下的背景设定。
works.idea_en: Recasts the game writer's job: instead of writing every line, the writer writes the person and then tests what the model makes of them.
works.idea_zh: 重新定义了游戏编剧的工作：不再逐句写台词，而是写出“这个人”，再检验模型如何演绎他。
works.method: Inworld's LLM-based character engine generates dialogue from authored backstories and guardrails, NVIDIA Audio2Face animates the faces, and performance capture from actors sets each character's expressive range.
works.method_zh: Inworld 基于大语言模型的角色引擎依据编写的背景与护栏生成对话，英伟达 Audio2Face 驱动面部动画，演员的表演捕捉决定每个角色的表现幅度。

works.title: Teammates
works.description: A playable first-person shooter level in which the player gives spoken orders to two AI squadmates, Pablo and Sofia, and to an in-game assistant, Jaspar, who can highlight enemies, explain lore, change settings or pause the game. It was playtested with a few hundred players.
works.description_zh: 一个可游玩的第一人称射击关卡：玩家用语音向两名 AI 队友 Pablo 与 Sofia，以及游戏内助手 Jaspar 下达指令；Jaspar 能标记敌人、讲解背景故事、调整设置或暂停游戏。该实验曾向数百名玩家开放测试。
works.idea_en: Moves generative NPCs from conversation to coordinated action: natural speech becomes the controller for teammates in a live combat situation.
works.idea_zh: 把生成式 NPC 从“聊天”推进到“协同行动”：在实时战斗情境中，自然语音成为指挥队友的操作方式。
works.method: Built on Ubisoft's Snowdrop engine; speech is transcribed and interpreted together with game-state context by an LLM layer (reported as Google Gemini with internal middleware) that selects squad behaviors and generates voiced replies.
works.method_zh: 基于育碧 Snowdrop 引擎；语音被转写后，与游戏状态上下文一起交给大语言模型层（据报道为 Google Gemini 与内部中间件）理解，由其选择小队行为并生成配音回复。

works.title: PUBG Ally
works.description: An AI teammate for PUBG: Battlegrounds that the player talks to by voice: it calls out enemies in game lingo, shares loot, drives vehicles and fights alongside the player. KRAFTON calls it a Co-Playable Character; after demos at CES 2025 and GDC 2026 it was playable in a two-week public beta, Ally Duo Mode in PUBG Arcade on Steam, from 17 to 30 June 2026.
works.description_zh: 《绝地求生》中可语音交流的 AI 队友：用游戏术语报点、分享物资、驾驶载具并与玩家并肩作战。魁匠团称之为“可共玩角色”（CPC）；在 CES 2025 与 GDC 2026 展示后，于 2026 年 6 月 17 日至 30 日在 Steam 版 PUBG 街机模式中以“Ally 双排模式”进行了为期两周的公开测试。
works.idea_en: A teammate that both talks and acts in a fast competitive game, running on the player's own GPU rather than in the cloud.
works.idea_zh: 一个在快节奏竞技游戏中既能说话又能行动的队友，运行在玩家自己的 GPU 上，而不是云端。
works.method: First shown with the Mistral-NeMo-Minitron-8B small language model through NVIDIA ACE; KRAFTON then moved from a behavior-tree-plus-SLM workflow to an autonomous tool-calling agent loop on a distilled on-device Nemotron model, adding long-term memory (announced at CES 2026).
works.method_zh: 最初通过英伟达 ACE 使用 Mistral-NeMo-Minitron-8B 小语言模型展示；随后魁匠团从“行为树 + 小模型”的工作流，转向在蒸馏后的本地 Nemotron 模型上运行的自主工具调用智能体循环，并加入长期记忆（CES 2026 宣布）。

works.title: inZOI Smart Zoi
works.description: In KRAFTON's life simulation inZOI, Smart Zoi lets every resident of a city act on its own life goals, react to events around it and adjust tomorrow's schedule from today's experiences, instead of waiting for player commands; players can read a Smart Zoi's inner thoughts as they happen and nudge them. The experimental setting shipped with the game's Steam early access in March 2025 for GeForce RTX GPUs.
works.description_zh: 在魁匠团的人生模拟游戏 inZOI 中，Smart Zoi 让城市里的每个居民依照自己的人生目标行动、对周围事件作出反应，并根据当天经历调整第二天的日程，而不是等待玩家指令；玩家可以实时查看 Smart Zoi 的内心想法并加以引导。这一实验性设置随游戏于 2025 年 3 月在 Steam 抢先体验上线，需要 GeForce RTX GPU。
works.idea_en: A whole simulated town of LLM-driven residents in a mass-market game, running locally, which is close to a playable Smallville.
works.idea_zh: 大众市场游戏中整座由 LLM 驱动居民构成的模拟小镇，并在本地运行，接近一个可玩的 Smallville。
works.method: A 0.5B-parameter Mistral-NeMo-Minitron small language model running on-device through NVIDIA ACE selects each Zoi's next action from the game's action set, guided by goals, memories and reflections, with the game simulation executing and animating the choice.
works.method_zh: 通过英伟达 ACE 在本地运行的 5 亿参数 Mistral-NeMo-Minitron 小语言模型，依据目标、记忆与反思，从游戏动作集中为每个 Zoi 选择下一步行动，再由游戏模拟系统执行并呈现动画。

works.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT AI Teammate
works.description: Since 27 March 2025, players of NetEase's NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Mobile PC Version (Chinese market) can add an on-device AI teammate to their party in Free Training: it fights alongside them, finds items they need, swaps gear and suggests which skills to unlock.
works.description_zh: 自 2025 年 3 月 27 日起，网易《永劫无间》手游 PC 版（国服）玩家可以在自由训练中邀请一名本地运行的 AI 队友：它与玩家并肩作战、寻找玩家需要的物品、交换装备，并建议解锁哪些技能。
works.idea_en: One of the first shipped LLM teammates in a large Chinese action game, run on the player's GPU rather than a server.
works.idea_zh: 最早在大型中国动作游戏中上线的 LLM 队友之一，运行在玩家的 GPU 上而不是服务器上。
works.method: Likely an NVIDIA ACE small language model on the local GeForce RTX GPU that picks high-level actions and suggestions, while the game's own combat AI executes moves; NetEase has not published model details.
works.method_zh: 很可能由本地 GeForce RTX GPU 上运行的英伟达 ACE 小语言模型选择高层行动与建议，再由游戏自身的战斗 AI 执行具体操作；网易未公开模型细节。

works.title: AI Darth Vader in Fortnite
works.description: Fortnite players could recruit Darth Vader to their squad and talk to him over the microphone; he answered in a synthesized James Earl Jones voice. Players got him to swear within hours, which Epic patched. The underlying tech went to creators as the Persona device, renamed Conversations and released as an experimental UEFN feature on 2026-04-16 (publishing not yet enabled).
works.description_zh: Fortnite 玩家可以招募达斯·维达加入小队，并用麦克风与他交谈；他以合成的 James Earl Jones 声音回答。上线数小时内就有玩家诱导他说脏话，Epic 随即修补。这项技术随后以 Persona 装置开放给创作者，后更名为 Conversations，并于 2026-04-16 作为 UEFN 实验功能推出（尚不能发布作品）。
works.idea_en: The largest public test of a licensed LLM character so far, and a clear lesson that a character's voice and persona need guardrails before release.
works.idea_zh: 迄今规模最大的授权 LLM 角色公开测试，也清楚表明：角色的声音与人设在上线前必须有护栏。
works.method: Push-to-talk speech goes to Google's Gemini 2.0 Flash, prompted with Vader's persona, and the text reply is voiced by ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 in a voice modeled on Jones, who had signed the rights over to Disney in 2022; reports say Conversations uses Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite with ElevenLabs.
works.method_zh: 按键说话的语音交给带有维达人设提示的 Google Gemini 2.0 Flash，文字回复再由 ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 以模仿 Jones 的声音合成（Jones 生前于 2022 年把声音权利授予迪士尼）；据报道 Conversations 使用 Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 与 ElevenLabs。

works.title: Whispers from the Star
works.description: An interactive science-fiction story in which the player keeps Stella, an astronaut stranded on an alien planet, alive by talking to her through a communicator; there are no dialogue options, and what she does next depends on what the player says.
works.description_zh: 一款互动科幻故事：玩家通过通讯器与困在外星球的宇航员 Stella 交谈，帮助她活下去；没有对话选项，她接下来做什么取决于玩家说了什么。
works.idea_en: A whole commercial game built on one LLM character and open voice conversation, which tests whether a single relationship can carry an experience.
works.idea_zh: 一整款商业游戏建立在单个 LLM 角色与开放语音对话之上，检验一段关系能否撑起完整体验。
works.method: Likely a proprietary LLM pipeline with speech recognition, a persona and story-state model for Stella, synthesized voice and rendered character animation; Anuttacon has not published technical details.
works.method_zh: 很可能是专有的大语言模型管线：语音识别、Stella 的人设与剧情状态模型、合成语音以及渲染的角色动画；Anuttacon 未公开技术细节。

works.title: Total War: PHARAOH AI advisor (NVIDIA ACE demo)
works.description: A CES 2026 tech demo that adds a talking advisor to Creative Assembly's strategy game Total War: PHARAOH: players ask about the game's systems and their current campaign, and the advisor answers in voice.
works.description_zh: CES 2026 上的技术演示：为 Creative Assembly 的策略游戏《全面战争：法老》加入一位会说话的顾问；玩家询问游戏系统和当前战局，顾问用语音回答。
works.idea_en: An NPC whose job is to coach the player inside the game, a pattern that maps directly onto tutors in training simulations.
works.idea_zh: 一个在游戏内辅导玩家的 NPC，这一模式可以直接迁移到训练模拟中的导师角色。
works.method: NVIDIA ACE runs speech recognition, a small language model grounded in game data and current game state, and speech synthesis on the local RTX GPU.
works.method_zh: 英伟达 ACE 在本地 RTX GPU 上运行语音识别、基于游戏数据与当前游戏状态的小语言模型，以及语音合成。

works.title: Suck Up!
works.description: A comedy game in which the player is a vampire who must talk AI-driven townsfolk into opening their doors, using disguises and improvised lies; each resident has a personality and reacts to what the player says. On Steam since October 2025.
works.description_zh: 一款喜剧游戏：玩家扮演吸血鬼，借助伪装和即兴谎言说服由 AI 驱动的镇民开门；每位居民都有自己的性格，并对玩家说的话作出反应。2025 年 10 月登陆 Steam。
works.idea_en: Persuasion of LLM characters as the whole mechanic, and a showcase of how players probe and break character prompts.
works.idea_zh: 把说服 LLM 角色作为全部玩法，也展示了玩家如何试探并突破角色提示词。
works.method: Likely a cloud LLM per character with persona prompts and game-state context (disguise, time, prior visits), speech recognition for voice input and synthesized replies; the developer has not published details.
works.method_zh: 很可能为每个角色调用云端大语言模型，结合人设提示与游戏状态上下文（伪装、时间、此前的拜访），配合语音输入识别与合成回复；开发者未公开细节。

leads.name: Dreamer 4: Training Agents Inside of Scalable World Models (Hafner et al., 2025)
leads.why: Owned by the world-models batch as danijar-hafner--dreamer-4 (also: agents, trend-agents-in-worlds); not added here.

leads.name: Odyssey PROWL-2 (2026-10-01)
leads.why: Agents and their world model learn together; flagged by the world-models batch. Related world-models works with agents: odyssey--agora-2, robbyant--lingbot-world-2, general-intuition--mira.

leads.name: Inworld Origins (2023 free Steam demo)
leads.why: Widely played detective demo of Inworld's character engine; only third-party videos found (AI and Games analysis).

leads.name: Inworld Realtime TTS-2 / speech-to-speech API (2026)
leads.why: Inworld's 2026 product focus is real-time voice models; belongs to the audio or infra batch.

leads.name: NetEase Justice Online Mobile (逆水寒手游) LLM-driven NPCs (2023)
leads.why: One of the first shipped Chinese MMOs with LLM NPCs; no official YouTube/X video found, only fan uploads.

leads.name: MIR5 AI boss (Wemade, NVIDIA ACE, CES 2025)
leads.why: Boss that adapts to player tactics using an on-device model; trailer via IGN.

leads.name: AI People (GoodAI)
leads.why: Sandbox game of LLM-driven NPCs (alpha 2024, ACE partner at CES 2025); game site now redirects to goodai.com, status unclear.

leads.name: Mantella / Herika (Skyrim LLM NPC mods)
leads.why: Community mods that gave Skyrim NPCs speech recognition, LLM dialogue and synthesized voices; widely used precursor of AI NPCs.

leads.name: Mindcraft (Emergent Garden)
leads.why: Open-source framework for LLM agents that play Minecraft with players; popular community videos.

leads.name: GARP on-device generative agents village (Studio Atelico)
leads.why: Real-time village simulation of on-device generative agents; talk at AI and Games Conference 2025.

leads.name: Meta Horizon Worlds AI NPCs (generative NPC tools in the Horizon editor)
leads.why: LLM-driven NPCs for VR worlds; belongs to the genxr batch (Horizon generative tools). Covered by work meta--horizon-worlds-llm-npcs (2026-10 update).

leads.name: TinyTroupe (Microsoft, 2024)
leads.why: Open-source library for LLM persona simulation for business research; smaller and less salient than Simile or OASIS.

leads.name: Video PreTraining (VPT, OpenAI 2022) and MineDojo (NeurIPS 2022)
leads.why: Precursors of NitroGen-style video-pretrained game agents; candidates for a historical anchor.

leads.name: Player-1: Training Game Agents on Synthetic Data (October 2026)
leads.why: Very recent game-agent paper seen in a YouTube summary; not yet verified on arXiv.

leads.name: SIMA 2 / Genie 3 agent research preview access
leads.why: Watch for wider SIMA 2 access or agents released inside Project Genie worlds (2026).
